srep-0082-crossfade-default.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.5">
<project width="64" height="36" fps="25" duration="2" background="#000000FF" seed="1"/>
<output id="mix" path="out/mix.wav" codec="audio-only" container="wav"/>
<assets>
<video id="ta" src="../assets/srep82-tone-500.mkv" width="64" height="36" fps="25" duration="2.2" hasAudio="true"/>
<video id="tb" src="../assets/srep82-tone-1250.mkv" width="64" height="36" fps="25" duration="2.2" hasAudio="true"/>
</assets>
<composition>
<layer id="a" asset="ta" end="1"/>
<layer id="b" asset="tb" start="1" clipIn="1"/>
<transition type="wipe" from="a" to="b" duration="0.4" curve="linear"/>
</composition>
</scene>

audio.note: no audio attribute: crossfade, a = 1 - p, b = p (Semantics 1, 2)

expected.pending: SREP 82 is a draft; the Rust reference implements it on branch fix/transition-audio (61a85ebf), not yet on main. The entry keeps the values derived from the SREP
